# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{collaborator}

Add or update a collaborator to a repository with specified permission level

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-252`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| collaborator | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `AddCollaboratorOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `permission` | RepoWritePermission | False | enum: read, write, admin |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User is blocked by repo owner or vice versa
- **404** — Repository not found
- **422** — Collaborator user does not exist
- **500** — Collaborator account is inactive

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.AddOrUpdateCollaborator | controller | Get form body; Get user by name; Check user is active; Parse permission; Call repo_service.AddOrUpdateCollaborator |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.AddOrUpdateCollaborator | service | Validate access mode; Load repo owner; Check user blocks; Within transaction: check existing collaboration; Insert or update collaboration; Recalculate user access |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Collaborator must be an active user account | validation | !collaborator.IsActive |
| User block check prevents adding blocked users as collaborators | authorization | IsUserBlockedBy(u, repo.OwnerID) || IsUserBlockedBy(repo.Owner, u.ID) |
| Access mode must be read, write, or admin | validation | mode < perm.AccessModeRead || mode > perm.AccessModeAdmin |
| Default permission is write when not specified | business_logic | form.Permission == nil |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| User blocked by repo owner or vice versa | 403 | forbidden | False |
| Collaborator account is not active | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **User does not exist** → repo.AddOrUpdateCollaborator → 422
- **User account is inactive** → repo.AddOrUpdateCollaborator → 500
- **User is blocked** → repo.AddOrUpdateCollaborator → 403
- **Invalid access mode** → repo_service.AddOrUpdateCollaborator → 500
